title: Moment Maps for a Classical Type I Dual Pair
body_html:
Moment Maps for a Classical Type I Dual Pair

Let \((G,G')=(U(V),U(V'))\) be a type I reductive dual pair and identify \[ W=V\otimes_D V'\simeq \operatorname{Hom}_D(V,V'). \] For \(w\in W\), let \(w^\ast\in \operatorname{Hom}_D(V',V)\) be the adjoint with respect to the two forms. The moment maps are \[ M:W\to \mathbf g,\qquad M(w)=w^\ast w, \] and \[ M':W\to \mathbf g',\qquad M'(w)=ww^\ast. \] They are equivariant for the \(G\times G'\)-action and connect oscillator-model orbits to Moy-Prasad data on both sides of the dual pair.
